annotations.title: Mark a referral request as referred

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Marks a claimed request as referred, meaning the referral was submitted in the company's own system. The candidate is told to watch their email for the company. Only for a request this referrer claimed, after the submission really happened.
name: mark_referral_request_referred

action.description: The action that was applied: claim, release, referred, decline or request_changes.

status_label.description: The new status as techjobs.vn shows it (Vietnamese).

title: Mark a referral request as referred
